resources.string: Move files from your computer\'s browser, no software needed
Creating the network and starting the server…
Transfer works both ways now: share files from here, or drop them onto the browser page
Join the network below on the computer, then open the link in a browser
Faster, but some computers cannot see 5GHz networks. Leave it off if the network does not appear.
Pick this network in the computer\'s Wi-Fi list and enter the password. The network and password stay the same, so the computer remembers them next time.
Type this address into Chrome, Edge or Safari, or scan the code
Files you pick here show up in the computer\'s browser for download
USB tethering detected. Open this link in the computer\'s browser or scan the code, no Wi-Fi needed
Connect the phone to the computer with a USB-C cable that carries data
Pull down the notification shade, tap the USB notification and choose File transfer
Open the tethering settings and turn on USB tethering
Cable connected. Choose File transfer mode, then turn on USB tethering; on some phones the switch stays grey until you do
Cable connected in File transfer mode. Now turn on USB tethering in the tethering settings
Waiting for the computer to get a network address…
On Windows 11 (24H2 or later) the link appears with an NCM driver automatically. If the connection does not show up after a few seconds, reconnect the cable.
Could not open the tethering settings automatically; open them from the phone settings
